newsitem.title: UK: Average discount rate at UK T-bill tender 6.6436%.
newsitem.headline: Average discount rate at UK T-bill tender 6.6436%.

text.p: The average rate of discount at the weekly tender of 91-day UK Treasury bills rose to 6.6436 percent from 6.5774 percent last week, the Bank of England said on Friday.
The 200 million stg offer attracted bids of 880 million stg. The pro rata price was 98.340.
The Bank also auctioned 300 million stg of 28-day bills at an average rate of discount of 6.5548 percent.
For those, it received bids of 2.22 billion stg. The pro rata price was 99.495.
Next week 200 million stg of 91-day bills will be on offer as well as 300 million stg of 28-day bills.
